ask.question: How many unit loads are in each location zone?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    iv.subsit,
    iv.zoncod,
    COUNT(DISTINCT iv.ulid20) AS unit_load_count
FROM live3.agv_inventory_view AS iv
GROUP BY
    iv.subsit,
    iv.zoncod
ORDER BY
    iv.subsit,
    iv.zoncod;

ask.question: How many unit loads are in each location zone?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    l.subsit,
    l.zoncod AS location_zone,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.ulid) AS unit_load_count
FROM [EUSKIRCHEN_simp].live3.unitld AS u
INNER JOIN [EUSKIRCHEN_simp].live3.locatn AS l
    ON l.subsit = u.subsit
   AND l.locatn = u.locatn
GROUP BY
    l.subsit,
    l.zoncod
ORDER BY
    l.subsit,
    l.zoncod;

ask.question: Total picked and shipped quantity per shipment status
Total picked and shipped quantity per shipment status
ask.sql:
SELECT
    s.shpsts AS shipment_status,
    SUM(CAST(ISNULL(sl.picked_qty, 0) AS bigint)) AS total_picked_qty,
    SUM(CAST(ISNULL(sl.shpqty, 0) AS bigint)) AS total_shipped_qty
FROM dbo.shipment AS s
INNER JOIN dbo.shipment_line AS sl
    ON sl.wh_id = s.wh_id
   AND sl.ship_id = s.ship_id
WHERE s.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND sl.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY s.shpsts
ORDER BY s.shpsts;

ask.question: Total picked and shipped quantity per shipment status
ask.sql:
SELECT
    s.shpsts AS shipment_status,
    SUM(CAST(ISNULL(sl.picked_qty, 0) AS bigint)) AS total_picked_quantity,
    SUM(CAST(ISNULL(sl.shpqty, 0) AS bigint)) AS total_shipped_quantity
FROM dbo.shipment AS s
INNER JOIN dbo.shipment_line AS sl
    ON sl.ship_id = s.ship_id
   AND sl.wh_id = s.wh_id
WHERE s.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND sl.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY s.shpsts
ORDER BY s.shpsts;

ask.question: Which WCS (warehouse control system) ids are configured for the warehouse?
ask.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    wcs_id
FROM dbo.wcsmst
WHERE wh_id = @wh_id;

ask.question: Which WCS (warehouse control system) ids are configured for the warehouse?
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP (200)
    w.wcs_id
FROM dbo.wcsmst AS w
WHERE w.wh_id = @wh_id
ORDER BY w.wcs_id;
